verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS work-management platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only a REST API, JavaScript/Python client libraries, an OpenAPI spec, an in-browser API explorer and an official MCP server. These are developer building blocks or adjacent capabilities, and none of them is an official command-line tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
